title: Lang NEXT 2014 Panel  Systems Programming in 2014 and Beyond
summary: A panel from the Lang NEXT 2014 conference on systems programming in 2014 and beyond. Language designers including Bjarne Stroustrup and Rob Pike discuss the topic, including C++ header compile times.
why: HN commenters point to it for how Go fit awkwardly into systems programming discussions and for a funny exchange about C++ compile times.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: The section is a bit funny, with the responses from the other participants.
